svg.text: THE FIRST VENICE · 10,000–20,000 INHABITANTS · 96 CHURCHES · MAJOR TRADING HUB OF THE ADRIATIC
WIDE ENOUGH FOR BYZANTINE TRADING VESSELS

RIVER DIVERSIONS → siltation of canals MALARIA → depopulation of northern lagoon TRADE SHIFT → Venice superseded Torcello EARTHQUAKES → structural damage (1117, 1223) Population collapsed from 10,000–20,000 to 14 today. Causes: river diversions, siltation, malaria, shifting trade routes to Venice. 96 CHURCHES AT PEAK · BYZANTINE + ARAB + FRANKISH COINS IN ARCHAEOLOGICAL DEPOSITS · MOSAIC GLASS FROM MEDITERRANEAN WORKSHOPS DATA: CALAON & CIANCIOSI (2020) · TORCELLO ARCHAEOLOGICAL SURVEY · ARCHIVIO DI STATO DI VENEZIA
